items.name: Azure Cosmos DB
items.description: Globally distributed, multi-model database service from Microsoft that supports multiple data APIs and offers low-latency, scalable access.

items.name: Core Data
items.description: Apple framework for managing object graphs and persisting application data on iOS and macOS, providing an abstraction over underlying storage.

items.name: Couchbase
items.description: Distributed NoSQL database combining document store and key-value capabilities, designed for high performance and horizontal scalability.

items.name: IndexedDB
items.description: Low-level browser API for storing and indexing structured data on the client side, enabling offline and performant web applications.

items.name: MongoDB
items.description: Document-oriented NoSQL database that stores data as JSON-like documents, used for flexible-schema application development at scale.

items.name: Realm
items.description: Object-oriented mobile database framework for iOS and Android apps, often used as a local data store alternative to SQLite or Core Data.
